Primary source case: patient with psychosis. Initial presentation: I just feel so... alone, you know? Like no matter how much I try to reach out or share things I care about, people just brush me off or change the subject. It's like I'm shouting into a void. I don't even know why I both.
I just feel so... alone, you know? Like no matter how much I try to reach out or share things I care about, people just brush me off or change the subject. It's like I'm shouting into a void. I don't even know why I bother anymore—it just leaves me feeling bitter and small, like my thoughts don't matter.
It's like this heavy weight in my chest, like I'm carrying something no one else sees. And it's not just about being ignored—it's like... I start wondering if there's something wrong with me. Why don't people want to listen? Am I just not interesting enough? It's exhausting to keep trying when it feels like I'm always an afterthought.
Yeah... that's it exactly. But what if that never happens? What if I'm just... not the kind of person people connect with? Sometimes I worry I'm just unlovable, like there's some missing piece in me that keeps me from being worth sticking around for. It's terrifying to think about.
I guess... yeah. It’s terrifying to imagine a life where I’m not ‘the reliable one.’ But what if I’m just... not enough on my own? What if I spend my whole life waiting for purpose to find me, and it never does?
Sometimes I wonder if I'm just... meant to feel this way. Like no matter what I do, I'll always be alone in it. It's not just about people not listening—it's like I don't even deserve to be listened to. That's the worst part. Like I'm not worth the effort.
I just feel so alone in this. I'm trying to learn Hebrew and keep up with religious practices, but there's no one around me who shares this journey. I don't have access to classes or a community, and it's frustrating because I don't even know if I'm doing thin
I think what I crave most is just... connection. Not just someone to correct my Hebrew grammar, but people who understand why this matters to me spiritually. I'm stuck in a place where I can't afford to move closer to a community, and online groups feel impers
Unworthy... yeah. Like I don't deserve good things, or even to take up space. Sometimes I think, 'What's the point?' I just feel so numb, like I'm watching life happen from behind glass. It's scary to admit that out loud.
It's like... I keep replaying all the times I ignored red flags because I wanted to believe in them. And now the kids are gone, and I don't even know if they understand why. I feel so powerless, like I failed them. Sometimes it reminds me of how my own parents
I just feel so... stuck. Like no matter what I try, I can't seem to get anything right. I start things with so much hope, but then I just... give up. It's like I'm not even worth the effort. I hate feeling this way, but I don't know how to stop.
I just feel so... empty lately. Like nothing really matters. I try to reach out to people, but it’s like no one really gets it, or they’re too busy. I’m stuck in this cycle of loneliness, and it’s suffocating. I don’t even know why I bother sometimes.
I guess it started when I was a kid. My dad was always pushing me to be perfect—if I got a B, it was like I failed. Now, even though he’s not around, it’s like I’ve taken over his job. And it’s not just about work... it’s like I don’t even know who I am withou

I just feel so... alone, you know? Like no matter how much I try to reach out or share things I care about, people just brush me off or change the subject. It's like I'm shouting into a void. I don't even know why I bother anymore—it just leaves me feeling bitter and small, like my thoughts don't matter.
It's like this heavy weight in my chest, like I'm carrying something no one else sees. And it's not just about being ignored—it's like... I start wondering if there's something wrong with me. Why don't people want to listen? Am I just not interesting enough? It's exhausting to keep trying when it feels like I'm always an afterthought.
Yeah... that's it exactly. But what if that never happens? What if I'm just... not the kind of person people connect with? Sometimes I worry I'm just unlovable, like there's some missing piece in me that keeps me from being worth sticking around for. It's terrifying to think about.
I guess... yeah. It’s terrifying to imagine a life where I’m not ‘the reliable one.’ But what if I’m just... not enough on my own? What if I spend my whole life waiting for purpose to find me, and it never does?
Sometimes I wonder if I'm just... meant to feel this way. Like no matter what I do, I'll always be alone in it. It's not just about people not listening—it's like I don't even deserve to be listened to. That's the worst part. Like I'm not worth the effort.
I just feel so alone in this. I'm trying to learn Hebrew and keep up with religious practices, but there's no one around me who shares this journey. I don't have access to classes or a community, and it's frustrating because I don't even know if I'm doing thin
I think what I crave most is just... connection. Not just someone to correct my Hebrew grammar, but people who understand why this matters to me spiritually. I'm stuck in a place where I can't afford to move closer to a community, and online groups feel impers

I just feel so... invisible. Like no matter what I do, people look right through me because I'm not pretty enough. It's like my worth is tied to how I look, and I keep falling short. I try to be kind, I try to be interesting, but none of it matters when I walk
